subject: Next steps & evaluation kickoff planning
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medquant.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T15:12:00Z
Subject: Next steps & evaluation kickoff planning

Hi Alicia — great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed plan to get the evaluation moving: 

- Summary from discovery: you want a lightweight eval focused on ingest/embedding throughput, retrieval latency for clinical notes, and precision on entity extraction for medication dosing.
- Proposed scope (2-week pilot): sample prompt set (50 examples), ingest ~100k notes via S3, measure latency and cost-per-token, run evals on extraction quality.
- Success criteria (draft): 95% entity extraction precision on the med/dose set OR latency < 350 ms 95th pct for 2k concurrent requests. We can refine this during kickoff.

Next steps: can we lock a 45-minute evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + prompt set handoff)? Please pick two preferred 45-min windows next week and I’ll send a calendar invite. Ben (SE) will lead the technical deep dive; Soojin will join to cover onboarding and security questions.

I attached an initial eval-charter-draft.pdf (high-level checklist) and a short prompt-pack-outline.csv for reference.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachment: eval-charter-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: prompt-pack-outline.csv (text/csv)

Agenda (45 min):

Subject: Re: Next steps & evaluation kickoff planning — tech items

Adding a few technical notes ahead of the kickoff and a lightweight runbook attached.

- Access: we’ll create scoped API keys for the eval and provide temporary IAM role for S3 read access. Please confirm a test S3 path or we can accept a sample upload during kickoff.
- Load profile: for latency validation we’ll run up to 2k qps sustained for short bursts and capture p95/p99 latency. We’ll include a cost delta for burst vs baseline.
- Prompt examples: please prioritize real-world clinical notes with anonymized PHI. For extraction evals, include both positive and edge-case examples where dosing is ambiguous.

I attached eval-runbook.pdf and a first pass prompt-pack-v1.csv — use the CSV as a template for your sample set. I’ll present the runbook section in the technical deep dive.

See you on Tue 2028-06-11 15:00 PDT.
